components.description: Deep brown shared action; 48px minimum target.
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:var(--font-sans,'Urbanist','Noto Sans SC Variable',sans-serif);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:32px;min-height:48px;padding:0 20px;background:var(--brand,#3C1008);color:var(--on-brand,#FFFDF9);font-size:1rem;font-weight:650;cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s,border-color .16s,color .16s}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--brand-strong,#582119)}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-button:focus-visible,.ds-field input:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible,.ds-chip:focus-visible,.ds-contact:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8360B1;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Familia App 的亲近陪伴"**

用户已确认用真实 Familia App 复现方向替换原有松绿体系。珊瑚、桃色和淡紫背景承托白色长圆选项、圆形头像与深棕主操作；视觉选择以实际实现为准，不另造概念。依据为 app/familia.css 对基础样式的覆盖及 components/Familia.jsx、components/Chat.jsx。批准稿 public/design-preview/familia-app-replica/index.html 与 .tmp-familia/review/replica-board.jpg 是视觉参照，不是生产用户素材库。

家庭影像与原声保留真实来源，AI 家人始终标明为个人陪伴设定。头像来自有权使用的图片，缺省为姓名首字或 Lucide 人物图标。新流程进入实际家庭记忆、历史会话和积分机制，保留原有权限与设置。

**Key Characteristics:**

- 柔和彩色渐变、白色胶囊和深棕操作。
- 自托管 Urbanist 配合中文 Noto 无衬线；忆伴字标保留 Noto 中文衬线。
- 绿色用户气泡与白色助手气泡，身份及来源清楚。
- 留白、真实状态和可见焦点优先。
keyCharacteristics: Coral, peach and lilac gradients with white pills.
Dark brown actions; sage user and white assistant messages.
Owned avatars, explicit AI identity and visible provenance.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Contact text inherits ink; sage user bubbles use fa-sage-ink. Preserve theme pairs.

rules.name: The Root Scale Rule
rules.body: Keep rem content and user-selected root sizing.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: Respect reduced-motion settings; local glows do not become universal elevation.

dos: Do reproduce the shipped Familia world.
Do retain night, high contrast, root sizing and reduced motion.
Do retain AI identity, media provenance, history and credit states.
donts: Do not use reference people as production profiles.
Do not present browser speech or saved video as live calls.
Do not invent mood records or diagnostic meaning.
